title: DomainWhitelist
description: A lightweight Paper/Velocity plugin that restricts server access to specific domains/IPs defined in the config. Players connecting through other addresses are denied with a customizable message.
body:
# 📖 Description
**DomainWhitelist** is a simple yet effective Paper/Velocity plugin that ensures players only join your server through the official domains you specify. This helps prevent confusion, protects your branding, and ensures players always connect via the correct entry point.

# ✨ Features
✅ Restrict access to only the domains/IPs listed in **config.yml**

✅ Fully customizable kick message with placeholder **%domains%**

✅ **/domains reload** command for reloading configuration without restarting

✅ Lightweight, minimal, and production‑ready

# 🔧 Commands & Permissions
**/domains reload** → Reloads the configuration

Permission: **domainwhitelist.reload** (default: OP)
